5.2.1 Online UPS. The power to system is provisioned through on-line UPS.
5.2.2 UPS is provisioned with maintenance free batteries.
Main Control Panel. 5.3.1 All sensors are monitored and controlled from one programmable controller with display. The control panel shall have following major features/indications:
Fault Diagnostic: Inbuilt fault diagnostic and scan facility for all units and sensors. System should indicate fault in MCP with address, zones, location & loop number.
External hooter provisioned in crew accommodation, service space, control station & machinery spaces.
Interface. System should have provision for interfacing with Battle Damage Control System (BDCS).
Password Protection. User control on MCP shall be password protected.
Event Logging. System shall have provision of online event logging of alarms with date & time for each addressable detector.
